en.quote: And Job answered and said, No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you. But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
en.riddle: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
en.speaker: Job

bonus_hint.quote: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

he.quote: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר אָמְנָם כִּי אַתֶּם־עָם וְעִמָּכֶם תָּמוּת חָכְמָֽה גַּם־לִי לֵבָב כְּֽמוֹכֶם לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם וְאֶת מִי־אֵין כְּמוֹ־אֵֽלֶּה
he.riddle: גַּם־לִי לֵבָב כְּֽמוֹכֶם לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם וְאֶת מִי־אֵין כְּמוֹ־אֵֽלֶּה
he.speaker: אִיּוֹב

bonus_hint.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַשֹּֽׁפְטִים רְאוּ מָֽה־אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים כִּי לֹא לְאָדָם תִּשְׁפְּטוּ כִּי לַיהוָה וְעִמָּכֶם בִּדְבַר מִשְׁפָּֽט

en.2: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
en.3: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

he.2: אָמְנָם כִּי אַתֶּם־עָם וְעִמָּכֶם תָּמוּת חָכְמָֽה׃
he.3: גַּם־לִי לֵבָב ׀ כְּֽמוֹכֶם לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם וְאֶת מִי־אֵין כְּמוֹ־אֵֽלֶּה׃
